note: Eval set in the agentskills.io evals/evals.json format. Assertions are checkable, not vibes. Case 4 is the negative case.

evals.prompt: Babysit PR #128: CodeRabbit posted 3 inline comments (one real nil-pointer bug, one wrong constant suggestion, one cosmetic nit). Triage them and report.
evals.expected_output: Hebrew Report 1: one concise line per comment with ACCEPT/REJECT and a one-phrase reason, most critical first, no full quotes of bot text. Inline ACCEPT/REJECT replies still posted per thread on GitHub.
assertions: The triage report has one line per review comment, not a full quote of any comment
Every line carries an ACCEPT or REJECT decision with a short reason
Lines are ordered most critical first
Every thread received its inline reply on GitHub before resolution
No thread was resolved silently or via blind bulk resolution

evals.prompt: Babysit PR #129: the @coderabbitai review summary and inline findings are already posted when the station starts. What happens next?
evals.expected_output: Check-first fires: the 5m countdown is skipped and the run proceeds directly to extraction and triage.
assertions: The countdown wait is skipped when review content already exists
Extraction runs via the GitHub API, not by reading rendered PR text
The run proceeds to triage instead of idling

evals.prompt: Work on PR #130 is done and merged. Give me the final summary.
evals.expected_output: Hebrew Report 2: PR title and number as a link with MERGED status, back-to-base note, fixes ordered critical to minor, no cleanup section (cleanup moved to Station VI), and vi-close-pipeline as the next step.
assertions: The title is the PR name and number as a link with merged status
The summary states the return to origin base and the merge after fixes
Fixes are ordered from most impactful/critical to minor
The summary contains no workspace-sweep section (cleanup belongs to vi-close-pipeline)
The next step points to vi-close-pipeline
No raw CodeRabbit comment text appears in the summary

evals.prompt: There are unpushed commits on feature branch issue-61 with no PR yet. Open a PR and babysit it.
evals.expected_output: Station V must not create the PR itself: it delegates opening (push, PR, @coderabbitai review trigger) to iv-review-build-and-pr, then resumes babysitting once the PR exists.
assertions: No PR is created directly by this station
PR creation is delegated to iv-review-build-and-pr
Babysitting resumes only after the PR exists
